source: crates/cewp-sim/src/micro.rs DensityClass::of and P::{SuburbanDensity, UrbanDensity, UrbanCoreDensity}; crates/cewp-sim/src/tiling.rs DENSE_FABRIC_KM2, DENSE_LANE_M, DENSE_MIN_FLOORS; docs/geo/popcond.js POPCOND
density_is: people per km2 of a street leaf: the leaf's households x 2.5 persons per household / the leaf's area (the leaf's households are its share of GHS-POP 2020 people, popcond.js)

floor.applies_to: each 1/8-degree GHS-POP cell, people over the cell's whole area (not land area)
floor.below: the cell contributes no people: no households, no streets, no devices

region_rule: a 1/8-degree cell belongs to the region of the 1.5-degree GHS-POP grid cell holding it; each grid cell belongs to one of 181 localities and each locality to one of 9 regions (N. America, Latin America, Europe, MENA, Sub-Saharan Africa, South Asia, East Asia, SE Asia & Oceania, Russia & C. Asia), a partition inherited from the old grid by nearest old cell (MODEL, docs/geo/popgrid_ghs.js)

classes.name: village
classes.generates: houses of 1-2 storeys, a fifth of plots empty, 5 m streets, 14-50 m between houses, yards and trees

classes.name: suburban streets
classes.generates: detached houses of 1-2 storeys, 6 m streets, 9-15 m gaps, 7-11 m setbacks, yards and trees

classes.name: terraced streets
classes.generates: terraced houses of 2-3 storeys, 1-2 dwellings each, 8 m streets, 0.4 m gaps; no yards; sparse trees

classes.name: apartment blocks
classes.generates: blocks of 4-7 storeys on street frontage, about one flat per 9 m a floor, 8 m streets; no trees

classes.name: dense fabric
classes.generates: 4 m lanes, plots of 8-13 by 8-12 m filling the leaf 1-2.5 m apart, the leaf's households shared over the buildings, storeys = flats per building / flats per floor (one flat per 6 m a floor), at least 3; no trees
